```{r}
pacman::p_load(here, cmdstanr, tidyverse, posterior, bayesplot, ggplot2, patchwork)
```

```{r}
data <- read_delim(here("simulation", "simulated_data.csv"))

draws_list <- readRDS(here("simulation", "simulated_draws.rds"))
```

```{r}
# After fitting, extract posterior means and compare to true values
recovery_df <- map_dfr(names(draws_list), function(id) {
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  true_vals <- data %>% 
    filter(subject_id == as.numeric(id)) %>% 
    slice(1)  # same value repeated for all trials
  
  tibble(
    id         = id,
    true_log_r = true_vals$log_r,
    true_log_q = true_vals$log_q,
    est_log_r  = mean(draws$log_r),
    est_log_q  = mean(draws$log_q),
    q_est_95_width = quantile((draws$log_q), probs = c(.975)) - quantile((draws$log_q), probs = c(.025)),
    r_est_95_width = quantile((draws$log_r), probs = c(.975)) - quantile((draws$log_r), probs = c(.025))

    
  )
})

# Plot true vs estimated
ggplot(recovery_df, aes(x = true_log_q, y = est_log_q)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = true_log_q-q_est_95_width, ymax=true_log_q+q_est_95_width)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Parameter Recovery: log_q",
       x = "True value", y = "Estimated posterior mean") +
  theme_minimal()


# Plot true vs estimated
ggplot(recovery_df, aes(x = true_log_r, y = est_log_r)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = true_log_r-r_est_95_width, ymax=true_log_r+r_est_95_width)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Parameter Recovery: log_r",
       x = "True value", y = "Estimated posterior mean") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Helper functions
make_update_df <- function(prior, posterior) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(value = prior,     type = "Prior"),
    tibble(value = posterior, type = "Posterior")
  )
}

make_update_plot <- function(df, title, xlab, true_val = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = value, fill = type, color = type)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Prior" = "blue", "Posterior" = "red")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Prior" = "blue", "Posterior" = "red")) +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = "Density", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  # Add true value line if provided
  if (!is.null(true_val)) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = true_val, 
                        linetype = "dashed", 
                        color = "black", 
                        linewidth = 0.8)
  }
  return(p)
}
```


```{r}
# Plots for selected participants
for (id in c("4", "10", "24")) {
  
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  
  # Get true values for this participant from simulated data
  true_vals <- data %>% 
    filter(subject_id == as.numeric(id)) %>% 
    slice(1)
  
  true_log_r <- true_vals$log_r
  true_log_q <- true_vals$log_q
  true_r     <- exp(true_log_r)
  true_q     <- exp(true_log_q)
  
  # On log scale
  df_logr <- make_update_df(draws$logr_prior, draws$log_r)
  df_logq <- make_update_df(draws$logq_prior, draws$log_q)
  
  # On natural scale
  df_r <- make_update_df(exp(draws$logr_prior), draws$r_value)
  df_q <- make_update_df(exp(draws$logq_prior), draws$q_value)
  
  p_logr <- make_update_plot(df_logr, title = "Log R",             xlab = "log_r",   true_val = true_log_r)
  p_logq <- make_update_plot(df_logq, title = "Log Q",             xlab = "log_q",   true_val = true_log_q)
  p_r    <- make_update_plot(df_r,    title = "R (natural scale)", xlab = "r_value", true_val = true_r)
  p_q    <- make_update_plot(df_q,    title = "Q (natural scale)", xlab = "q_value", true_val = true_q) + xlim(0, 1)
  
  print(
    (p_logr | p_logq) / (p_r | p_q) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = paste("Prior-Posterior Update: Participant", id),
        caption = "Dashed line = true simulated value",
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
      )
  )
}
```
